summary: Frontend-only verification of iter17: one-click task creation from highlighted action_item transcript rows. All 7 acceptance criteria pass. Used the seeded Max Brenner call (call-card 11bf8762...) which contains 2 ACTION_ITEM highlights. Verified +TASK button visibility scoping, pre-fill content, AI task generation/assignee resolution, persistence via POST /api/tasks, and taskSourceText reset behavior.
verified_features: +TASK button (data-testid=hl-create-task-<segId>) renders ONLY on rows where hl.kind === 'action_item'. Verified by enumerating all transcript rows: 1 RISK row, 1 QUESTION row, 1 DECISION row showed NO task button; 2 ACTION rows BOTH showed the button.

Clicking hl-create-task-105068fe... opened SuggestTasksDialog with sourceMessage.body = 'Amit Patel: Agreed. Raj — can you finalize the shortlist by next Friday?' (verified via captured /api/ai/suggest-tasks request payload).

AI returned 1 well-formed task with title='Finalize the shortlist', populated description, assignee=Raj Mehta, priority='high', due_date=2026-05-21. Assignee correctly resolved to Raj's user id when Amit's segment names 'Raj'.

Second +TASK click (hl-create-task-73586ee9...) produced source='Raj Mehta: Yes, I'll have the comparison deck and visit photos ready.' and AI returned 2 tasks (Prepare comparison deck + Compile visit photos), both correctly assigned to Raj Mehta.

CREATE TASK & NOTIFY successfully POSTed to /api/tasks with payload {title:'Finalize the shortlist', assigned_to:'e323cf74-b4ba-4836-803c-4e8814a57ce5' (Raj Mehta id), due_date:'2026-05-22', priority:'high', status:'todo', source_chat_id:'57c27f27...'}. Dialog closed after success.

After dialog closes, taskSourceText state correctly resets. Clicking bottom 'mtg-create-tasks' button afterwards triggered /api/ai/suggest-tasks with summaryMd ('## TL;DR Edited by test ## Action items - test action') as message_body, NOT the previously-used segment text. No stale source bleed-through.

Regression: Meeting Notes dialog opens, AI HIGHLIGHTS chip bar (1 DECISION / 2 ACTIONS / 1 RISK / 1 QUESTION) renders, SUMMARY ↔ TRANSCRIPT tab switching works, transcript annotation badges (DECISION, ACTION, RISK, QUESTION) render with correct colors and icons, Export PDF/Word buttons present, Edit transcript and Replace from audio still visible.
critical_code_review_comments: MeetingSummaryDialog.jsx is now 522 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but trending up. Consider extracting AnnotatedTranscript and HL_STYLES/HlChip into their own file (e.g., MeetingTranscriptView.jsx) before the next iteration.

Minor: The seeded Max Brenner call summary has been corrupted by prior test runs (now reads 'TL;DR Edited by test ... Action items - test action'). Not a bug from this iter, but seed-data refresh would make demos cleaner.
